record.original_question: Fix an integer k >= 3 and a small epsilon_0 >= 0. Asymptotically evaluate the mean value integral from 0 to T of (sum_{m <= T^(2+epsilon_0)} d_k(m) / m^(1/2+it)) (sum_{n <= T^(2+epsilon_0)} d(n) / n^(1/2-it)) dt.

evidence.quote: Let k in N and k >= 3. For some small ǫ0 >= 0 asymptotically evaluate integral from 0 to T of sum_{m<=T^(2+ǫ0)} d_k(m)/m^(1/2+it) times sum_{n<=T^(2+ǫ0)} d(n)/n^(1/2-it) dt.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k \geq 3$ be an integer. For a positive integer $n$, let $d(n)$ denote the number of positive divisors of $n$, and let $d_k(n)$ denote the number of ordered factorizations of $n$ as a product of $k$ positive integers (so $d_2 = d$). For real $T > 0$ and a small fixed real number $\varepsilon_0 \geq 0$, consider the mean value
$$
I_k(T) \;=\; \int_0^T \Bigg(\sum_{m \leq T^{2+\varepsilon_0}} \frac{d_k(m)}{m^{1/2 + it}}\Bigg)\Bigg(\sum_{n \leq T^{2+\varepsilon_0}} \frac{d(n)}{n^{1/2 - it}}\Bigg)\,dt.
$$
Obtain an asymptotic evaluation of $I_k(T)$ as $T \to \infty$ (including, ideally, lower-order main terms together with a power-saving error term).
artifact.category_tag: Mean values of long Dirichlet polynomials
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work establishes asymptotics for mean values of long Dirichlet polynomials with higher divisor coefficients, but typically conditional on a smoothed additive divisor conjecture and for shorter lengths or one-sided cases. The specific unconditional asymptotic for the cross moment of $d_k$ and $d$ on Dirichlet polynomials of length $T^{2+\varepsilon_0}$ for general $k \geq 3$ appears to remain open; it is part of the Conrey–Keating program on long Dirichlet polynomial mean values.

status_evidence.title: Mean values of long Dirichlet polynomials with higher divisor coefficients
status_evidence.snippet: Asymptotic formulas for mean values of long Dirichlet polynomials with higher order shifted divisor functions, assuming a smoothed additive divisor conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Existing asymptotic results in this direction are conditional on additive divisor conjectures.

status_evidence.title: Conditional mean values of long Dirichlet polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Conditional mean values of long Dirichlet polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: Mean value asymptotics for long Dirichlet polynomials with divisor coefficients are obtained conditionally.
